items.context: @cryptorover (1.623.083 seguidores), en inglés, con imagen: "Bitcoin Halving Progress: 65%"; dice que esta señal predijo cada piso de $BTC ("You know what that means..."). Publicado hace ~16 min: 104 likes, 11 reposts, 26 respuestas, 19.123 vistas. Tema halving y emisión.
items.suggested_text:
The halving clock has lined up with past bottoms for a mechanical reason more than a magical one. Every four years the block subsidy is cut in half, and miners, the only structural sellers of new supply, have to adapt. Today that's roughly 450 BTC a day hitting the market. After the next halving it drops to about 225, from 3.125 to 1.5625 BTC per block, with only 3.125% of the 21M left to be issued.

At 65% of the cycle, though, new supply isn't what's moving price. Demand is: ETF flows, forced sellers and how patient long-term holders are willing to be.

The more interesting question for $BTC is what the cycle looks like once issuance is too small to matter at all.
